episodes.synopsis: Shiraki is an angel loved by everyone. However, it's all an act, a façade, a lie to make her absolute dream come true; Marry into wealth!
episodes.title: Welcome to Liebe Girls Academy

episodes.synopsis: Hime fails to hide the truth of her new job when Kanoko follows her to work, and the surprises continue when Kanoko interviews to become the newest waitress at Café Liebe.
episodes.title: Let's All Be Waitresses Together

episodes.synopsis: Hime's quest to win over her Onee-sama continues, until she accidentally lets her secret slip and her façade falls down around her.
episodes.title: What Should I Believe?

episodes.synopsis: Once Mitsuki reveals her real name on her school ID, Hime suddenly remembers an important and painful memory from her past involving someone she used to consider a trusted friend.
episodes.title: I Hate You

episodes.synopsis: Hime and Mitsuki struggle to put their history behind them, but their real feelings bubble up and it starts to affect their café work. Mai, Sumika, and Kanoko try to intervene.
episodes.title: If We Could Start Over

episodes.synopsis: Hime tries to find a way to save Mitsuki and dispel the rumors swirling about them, but discovers the answer is a lot simpler than she thought. Meanwhile, Sumika starts to look a little bit closer at Kanoko.
episodes.title: So There's No Need for Lies Anymore?

episodes.synopsis: The café is busier than ever as the Blume election approaches. Fearful that her true feelings for Hime have been discovered, Kanoko becomes suspicious of Sumika's motivations.
episodes.title: It's Called Gyaru, Right?

episodes.synopsis: Kanoko's jealousy of Hime's closeness with Mitsuki begins to reach a breaking point, but Sumika moves to both help her and stand in her way.
episodes.title: For Whom Shall I Cast My Vote?

episodes.synopsis: Retreating from Sumika's confrontation, Kanoko reminisces about how she and Hime became friends.
episodes.title: The One and Only

episodes.synopsis: Sumika reveals why she's determined to block Kanoko's romantic feelings toward Hime, but after Kanoko brushes her off, a conversation with another employee forces her to consider a different perspective on romance in the salon.
episodes.title: Will You Break It All?

episodes.synopsis: The Blume election results are in, and Sumika is determined to make things right with Kanoko.
episodes.title: Blume der Liebe

episodes.synopsis: The shift into summer means changes in Liebe Girls' Academy salon, but the new summer uniforms cause an unexpected problem with Mitsuki, and tea recommendations leave Hime outclassed. Luckily, her Onee-sama is there to save the day.
episodes.title: Welcome to Summer at Liebe Girls' Academy!
